about.label: About me
about.heading: Software, data & AI someone uses every day.

bio.paragraph1: I started out building WordPress sites and managing hosting. Today I design and ship AI systems. In between, backend, data and applied AI.
bio.paragraph2: I move from data model to frontend, but my job right now is RAG, MCP and MLOps over corporate data: databases nobody documented, scanned PDFs, spreadsheets with fifteen tabs.
bio.paragraph3: I also teach, sort of: talks on AI and data science at universities —EGADE, UPVM Tultitlán, TESCo—, around 200 people per session.

work.description: From building WordPress sites to shipping AI to production. Here's what I did at each company.

appliedai.title: Applied AI Engineer
achievements: I bring AI into the team's internal processes and into the financial software the consultancy builds for its clients.

architect.title: AI Solutions Architect
achievements: Connie, from zero to production: I wrote 80% of the system. A RAG platform now serving 3 clients over their databases, PDFs and spreadsheets, with enterprise auth.
End-to-end RAG pipelines on Azure: ingestion, chunking, retrieval and serving, with prompt observability.
MCP servers connecting internal data sources to LLM clients: models consume tools without bespoke glue code.
Brought MLOps practices into the team: retrieval evaluation, prompt and model versioning.

fullstack.title: Fullstack Developer
achievements: Desktop apps in .NET and Python for the shop floor, running 24/7.
Internal web apps with .NET and DevExpress for operations workflows.
Database design and administration on SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
Android app with RFID reader for field inventory and traceability.

junior.title: Junior Fullstack Developer
achievements: Database maintenance and technical documentation of the stack.

webdev.title: Junior Web Developer
achievements: Websites and support with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and CMS: WordPress, Joomla, OpenCart.
